verses.text: I will bless the LORD at all times: His praise shall continually be in my mouth. ב Bet
My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: The humble shall hear thereof, and be glad. ב Bet
O magnify the LORD with me, And let us exalt his name together. ד Dalet
I sought the LORD, and he heard me, And delivered me from all my fears. ה He
They looked unto him, and were lightened: And their faces were not ashamed. ז Zain
This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, And saved him out of all his troubles. ח Het
The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, And delivereth them. ט Tet
O taste and see that the LORDis good: Blessed is the man that trusteth in him. י Yod
O fear the LORD, ye his saints: For there is no want to them that fear him. כ Kaph
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: But they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing. ל Lamed
Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD. מ Mem
What man is he that desireth life, And loveth many days, that he may see good? נ Nun
Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile. ס Samek
Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it. ע Ain
The eyes of the LORDare upon the righteous, And his ears are open unto their cry. פ Pe
The face of the LORDis against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth. צ Zade
The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, And delivereth them out of all their troubles. ק Qoph
The LORDis nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; And saveth such as be of a contrite spirit. ר Resh
Many are the afflictions of the righteous: But the LORD delivereth him out of them all. ש Shin
He keepeth all his bones: Not one of them is broken. ת Taw
Evil shall slay the wicked: And they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: And none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
